capabilities: Rescore Quick switcher results so emoji-prefixed note names rank as if typed without the emoji
Apply the same emoji-insensitive comparison to link suggestions and aliases
Preserve native fuzzy search, highlights, attachment options and excluded-files penalties
Fall back to native search with a one-time notice if internal Obsidian methods change
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installed via BRAT or manually; requires Obsidian 1.15+; wraps internal Obsidian methods and may fall back to native search after Obsidian updates; not yet tested on mobile.
intentEvidence: makes both searches ignore emojis in note names and aliases when your query contains no emoji
motivation: The README says it implements a behavior 'as proposed on the Obsidian forum', addressing how emoji-prefixed names are ranked.
problem: Notes whose names start with an emoji rank below notes starting directly with the query text in Quick switcher and [[ link suggestions.
summary: Search rescorer that makes Quick switcher and link suggestions ignore emojis in note names when the query has none.
